orgStructure.title: Structure
orgStructure.description: Departments and teams, with their parents, leads and codes. Units are only created: a name the company already has is an error.

peopleCreate.title: People
peopleCreate.description: Every row becomes a new person, as a draft. Nobody already here is changed: an email that already belongs to somebody is an error.

leaveBalances.title: Leave balances
leaveBalances.description: Each person's balance on a date, per policy — a target, not an addition, so the same file twice changes nothing. The policy must be assigned first.

upload.intro: Bring a company in from spreadsheets: its structure first, then its people, then their leave balances. Nothing is written until a file has no errors — the check lists every problem in every row, and you can fix a row right there or download the file back with an Errors column.
upload.noPermission: You do not have permission to import anything.
upload.templateHint: One column per field you may fill, with lists to pick from and an Instructions sheet.
upload.uploadHint: CSV (UTF-8) or XLSX, up to {maxMb} MB and 2,000 rows. Only the first sheet is read.
upload.tooLarge: The file is larger than {maxMb} MB.

map.rowsHint: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} · Match each column to a field, or leave it out.
map.notAllowed: You may not import this field.
map.datesHint: 2026-03-04 is always read. Real date cells in XLSX need no answer.

preview.errorRows: {count, plural, one {# row has} other {# rows have}} errors. Nothing is imported until there are none — fix them here, or in the file.

checkErrors.attention: {count, plural, one {# row needs} other {# rows need}} attention.

confirm.willBeCreated: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} will be created, each as a draft profile.
confirm.startLater: {count, plural, one {# person has} other {# people have}} a hire date after today, so they are Not started until then.
confirm.withoutEmail: {count, plural, one {# person has} other {# people have}} no email: they cannot be invited, and uploading this file again would create them again.
confirm.nobodyNotified: Nobody is notified. Onboarding does not start by itself.
confirm.inviteLabel: Invite everybody with an email once the import is done
confirm.inviteHint: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} will get an invitation to sign in — only after every row has been created.
confirm.structureCreated: {departments, plural, one {# department} other {# departments}} and {teams, plural, one {# team} other {# teams}} will be created, parents first, all at once.
confirm.structureNobodyPlaced: Nobody is placed in them yet: the people import does that.
confirm.balancesSet: {count, plural, one {# balance} other {# balances}} will be set, all at once.
confirm.balancesUnchanged: {count, plural, one {# is} other {# are}} already at the target and will not change.
confirm.balancesAsOf: Each balance is set as of its date. Leave already booked for later dates is subtracted on its own.

progress.rows: {done} of {total} rows. You can leave this page — the import carries on and the report waits here.

report.stoppedPeople: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} had been created before it stopped. They are in the People table as drafts.
report.stoppedWhole: Nothing was written: this file is applied whole or not at all. Fix what changed and import it again.
report.failed: {count, plural, one {# row was} other {# rows were}} not created — something changed after the check.
report.unchanged: {count, plural, one {# balance was} other {# balances were}} already at the target.
report.invited: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} invited.
report.noInvitations: No invitations were sent, because a row failed.
report.inviteCreated: Invite the {count, plural, one {# Person} other {# People}} Created
